name: Bounded residual adaptation of a frozen contextual two-hop retriever
status: The benchmark and model protocol were fixed before training and evaluation on the new 2Wiki cohort.
motivation: Learned projections can distort pretrained E5 geometry. Anchor the score to frozen E5 and bound the learned residual.

data.source: Official MuSiQue-Ans v1.0 train; strict two-hop reference structure and two distinct supports
data.split: Reuse the fixed 4,927 training, 100 validation and 200 lockbox questions. The lockbox had been inspected previously.
data.selection_metric: Terminal R@1 on tune only, same criterion for every condition
data.lockbox: Only selection-stage models are scored on the previously examined lockbox.
data.refit: Fresh initialization on all 14374 eligible official training examples; ceil(selected_steps * 14374 / n_purged_train)
data.official_dev: All1252 strict2hop MuSiQue dev; previously inspected source, exploratory
data.external: All remaining eligible strict directed two-hop 2Wiki dev examples after excluding prior 2000 evaluation IDs and known normalized question matches. Input-only manifest locks exact counts and clean masks before encoding/prediction. New instances from an already studied distribution, not a new dataset. Hotpot7405 is now seen and exploratory.

features.pooling: bf16 encoder, masked float32 mean, L2 normalized

optimization.tie_break: earliest checkpoint; first cap; first learning rate
optimization.random_label: fixed uniformly sampled valid candidate per example/seed, independent of gold
optimization.initialization: paired U random and V zero; step zero is raw E5 for every condition and always eligible on tune terminal R@1

decoding.terminal_primary: argmax exact marginal over all first candidates
decoding.support_pair_primary: argmax unordered pair probability, sum both ordered path probabilities
decoding.no_revisit: exclude self-transition in every path model and distinct comparator
decoding.direct: unconstrained terminal argmax and distinct top2; additionally fixed globally normalized pair energy from raw E5 first scores plus learned direct terminal scores
decoding.intervention: replace each contextual source vector by the original question in each trained contextual model, retaining first scores and no-revisit mask

reporting.interval: paired95% Student-t across5seeds on fixed examples, descriptive, no multiplicity correction
limits: Frozen encoder and supplied candidates; not full-corpus QA or an official MDR reproduction
New source lockbox is drawn from a corpus used in earlier studies; it is model-specific held-out evidence
Pretraining and Wikipedia overlap remain possible
No guarantee of positive results or universal superiority
Bounded score changes and tune step-zero fallback do not guarantee test accuracy preservation. Source/Hotpot outcomes cannot be called independent in this study.

score: 20 cosine(x,y) + residual_cap*tanh(6 * dot(Ux,Vy)); U random, V exactly zero; shared U,V across both hops; raw E5 vectors remain fixed. No extra KL penalty or post-test gating.
